details: Bitcoin experienced a price dip on Monday, falling below $63,000 as renewed hostilities between the U.S. and Iran in the Middle East intensified. This geopolitical uncertainty has led to a "risk-off" sentiment across global markets, prompting investors to pull away from riskier assets like cryptocurrencies. Oil prices also surged in response to the escalating tensions, contributing to broader inflation fears. The crypto market saw significant leveraged liquidations as a result of the price movements.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $63K Amid Escalating US-Iran Tensions

details: President Donald Trump has publicly pressed the Senate to pass the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, a key piece of legislation aimed at establishing a comprehensive regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies in the United States. The proposed bill seeks to define jurisdictional boundaries between the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) concerning digital assets. This move is intended to reduce market uncertainties and could potentially encourage greater institutional investment in the crypto sector.
title: Trump Urges Senate to Pass CLARITY Act for Crypto Regulatory Certainty

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded a significant $197.4 million in net inflows for the week ending July 10, effectively snapping an eight-week streak of consecutive outflows. Similarly, spot Ethereum ETFs also saw positive net inflows of $84.4 million during the same period, ending their prolonged outflow run. This development indicates a potential resurgence in institutional demand and a stabilization of sentiment towards leading digital assets, although the recovery is described as modest compared to previous outflows.
title: US Spot Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs End Eight-Week Outflow Streak with Inflows
